Year over year the level is also lower: unadjusted claims for the week ending 2026-11-14 were 197,492 against 218,228 a year earlier (fact 3).

Bloomberg notes that holiday weeks swing (fact 5), and DOL's technical notes say the series is 'difficult to seasonally adjust', so a move of more than 1,000 either way is possible.

Time zone: the DOL release time is 8:30 a.m.

Revisions: the question counts only the first published figure for the week ending 2026-11-21; the FRED value shown for later weeks is a later vintage and must not be substituted.
Threshold: 'above 203,000' is strict, so exactly 203,000 is not above and resolves No; the most recent prior print is exactly 203,000, so a tie is directly relevant.
